recognize_zh: 高倍下多數為大型芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻均勻，周圍一圈中等量深藍色胞質、偶見少許細顆粒，視野中僅見一個小淋巴球與一個成熟中細胞，缺乏顆粒球系成熟階段，支持 AML without maturation。
features: Large blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei
Finely granular, evenly dispersed chromatin; nucleoli indistinct at this resolution
Moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, occasionally with sparse fine azurophilic granules
Maturing granulocytic cells essentially absent; rare small lymphocyte and single maturing myeloid cell
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows sheets of large blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and a moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, a few containing sparse fine azurophilic granules. Auer rods are not seen. Maturing granulocytic precursors are virtually absent, with only a rare lymphocyte and an occasional maturing myeloid cell present. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia without maturation.

ddx.vs: Requires ≥10% maturing granulocytic cells beyond the blast stage, which are not present in this field.
The presence of any cytoplasmic azurophilic granules favors myeloid blasts; ALL is MPO-negative with lymphoid markers on flow.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray cytoplasm and folded nuclei, and are NSE positive and CD14/CD64 positive.
APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei with many fine granules or Auer rod bundles and are strongly MPO positive with PML::RARA.
